mapping_policy: Each file inherits every first-parent task interval and B1-B7/section gate that changed it; two non-Phase-2 repository-context intervals remain explicit.

TASK-260712-14rxuk.title: Freeze the Phase 2 gate matrix and lab contract
TASK-260712-14rxuk.acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance and reviewer task starts with the same dated pass or fail criteria, topology, fixture hashes and evidence paths. Exact 5 s start, 3 s seek, 100 ms skew, 200 MiB RSS, bounded duration, load and seven-day rules are fixed. Missing lab, participant, beta or authority input is visible and no later task can lower a gate or invent evidence.

TASK-260712-14u0yk.title: Freeze hard gates, fixtures and the streaming proof harness
TASK-260712-14u0yk.acceptance_criteria: Every section 20.2 proof and relevant B1 or 20.5 threshold maps to a reproducible fixture, sample count, command and artifact. Candidate tasks share identical inputs and cannot move gates after seeing results. The shortlist, supported containers, hardware and failure criteria are explicit, and security or decoder crashes count as rejection.

TASK-260712-17w78q.title: Implement the Windows bounded streaming provider
TASK-260712-17w78q.acceptance_criteria: Windows starts before full download with p95 at most 5 s, seeks to audio p95 at most 3 s, stays at or below 200 MiB RSS for B1 and remains duration-bounded at two hours. It rejects stale generations, survives network resets and eviction, purges revoked cache, reports ended after ring drain and passes realtime, clip and Spotify regressions.

TASK-260712-17yizc.title: Freeze Air lifecycle, activation, alias and policy contracts
TASK-260712-17yizc.acceptance_criteria: One reviewed contract fixes endpoint and callback fields, statuses, authorization, audit, one-active conflict, capacity, invite security, saved versus active state, join catch-up, leave or dissolve audio behavior, policy defaults, aliases and rollback cutover. A joining primary must confirm, parked rooms do not auto-delete or run audio, accepted target snapshots do not change retroactively, and target or inbox details remain owned by their story.

TASK-260712-1c34fe.title: Extend the common transmission service to N explicit targets
TASK-260712-1c34fe.acceptance_criteria: Personal delivery works for one or many recipients with no broadcast fallback, duplicate node or transitive Air delivery. Targets cannot be forged or enumerated and remain immutable after acceptance. Track and clip behavior follows one explicit capability policy, replay cannot inherit stale rights or ordering, and transport adapters contain no target business logic.

TASK-260712-1canzv.title: Probe exact bundled signed decoder candidates
TASK-260712-1canzv.acceptance_criteria: Both platforms have measured, signed and reproducibly packaged prototypes or exact rejection evidence. All required binary dependencies and notices are present, the package works offline after install, no unsigned or downloaded code appears, hostile input cannot escape the chosen containment, and no shipping or update assumption remains implicit.

TASK-260712-1kfnpu.title: Root Phase 2 line-by-line integration review
TASK-260712-1kfnpu.acceptance_criteria: The root review resource names every diff and scenario, commands and results, independent findings and dispositions, exact accepted build or package hashes and residual risks. No Phase 2 task is accepted from self-report, no Phase 1 regression or hard gate is waived and only the root-reviewed build may enter B1-B7 final acceptance or beta.

TASK-260712-1n5fks.title: Add track, variant, seek and playback persistence
TASK-260712-1n5fks.acceptance_criteria: Fresh and migrated data deterministically selects a pinned variant profile, maps time to ranges, rejects stale processing or seek state and restores queue and audible progress. Phase 1 clip, transmission and Spotify rows remain unchanged, old binaries ignore new rows without deleting them and no user-controlled key or duplicate target model appears.

TASK-260712-1q2kwa.title: Build the shared long-track UI and control model
TASK-260712-1q2kwa.acceptance_criteria: Windows and macOS consume identical RU and EN state, validation and action capabilities from file pick through played receipt. Processing and playback progress are distinguished, seek generations and failures are honest, local drafts survive outage, and the UI cannot bypass consent, target, queue, quota or moderation policy.

TASK-260712-1vdlkw.title: Audit exact codec licenses, patents, supply chain and packaging
TASK-260712-1vdlkw.acceptance_criteria: Each exact candidate is classified shippable, shippable with enumerated obligations or rejected, with URLs, retrieval date, packaged binary shape, notices and unresolved legal decision. No unknown transitive license, downloaded executable, GPL-incompatible distribution assumption, unpatched binary or vague patent claim reaches the ADR.

TASK-260712-1vklop.title: Prove B5-B7 target, inbox and rights semantics
TASK-260712-1vklop.acceptance_criteria: Automated evidence maps B5-B7 and every story invariant. It catches target enumeration, current-membership ACL, duplicate or transitive delivery, cursor leak, stale or automatic replay, parallel moderation state, consent bypass and silent mixed-version behavior. Both platform combinations and Telegram share the same expected fixtures, with real-world proof named where automation is insufficient.

TASK-260712-20cuna.title: Document rollout migration order and downstream handoff
TASK-260712-20cuna.acceptance_criteria: One implementation note links the final contract diagrams tests and rollout sequence so downstream work does not rediscover inbox or target semantics from code.

TASK-260712-25862f.title: Persist and enforce versioned Air policies
TASK-260712-25862f.acceptance_criteria: Unauthorized commands fail with stable privacy-safe reasons at every transport; allowed actions survive restart. Pairwise migrated Airs receive documented defaults. Concurrent policy changes serialize, audit is complete, accepted target ACL never expands retroactively, and no alias, app, bot or automation path bypasses local controls.

TASK-260712-285pag.title: Implement secure audio_track ingest and canonical variants
TASK-260712-285pag.acceptance_criteria: One-hour and maximum-bound inputs produce only the pinned, integrity-verifiable ready variants and honest metadata or a stable failure. Missing consent, corrupt, oversized, unsupported, quota, worker crash and delete races never publish partial media. Original and temporary bytes follow retention, no full WAV persists, clip and Telegram voice pipelines remain green and track audio is not destructively speech-normalized without an explicit ADR decision.

TASK-260712-28mn7w.title: Independent Phase 2 streaming performance and realtime review
TASK-260712-28mn7w.acceptance_criteria: The independent report verifies 5 s start, 3 s seek, 100 ms skew, 200 MiB RSS and duration-independent resource bounds without realtime violations, stale generations, quota mismatch or regressions. Critical and high findings are fixed and re-reviewed before root acceptance.

TASK-260712-298tyq.title: Probe Windows Media Foundation inside the signed AppContainer package
TASK-260712-298tyq.acceptance_criteria: The signed packaged prototype passes every required format and performance gate or is rejected with the exact unsupported format, OS build, API, timing, memory, architecture or sandbox evidence. It never depends on developer mode, runFullTrust, undocumented APIs or render-thread work and is reproducible from a pinned package and machine matrix.

TASK-260712-2bjdlb.title: Map pairwise approach flows to the Air service
TASK-260712-2bjdlb.acceptance_criteria: Existing users see the same two-party semantics and no raw Air or link IDs, but all accepted operations mutate Air state only. No stale link or repeated alias can create a second runtime, duplicate broadcast or transitive chain. Decline, withdraw, apart and restart behavior remain stable and personal orbit state is preserved.

TASK-260712-2bk0vy.title: Extend Phase 1 target snapshots with inbox and replay lineage
TASK-260712-2bk0vy.acceptance_criteria: Fresh and upgraded data supports N targets and exactly one inbox item per eligible missed target, stable replay lineage and deterministic pagination. Current Air membership cannot grant old access, leaving cannot broaden access, delete or disable revokes future fetch and replay, and Phase 1 targets, receipts, media and pairwise compatibility remain intact under rollback.

TASK-260712-2ctf3x.title: Implement versioned content-policy acceptance
TASK-260712-2ctf3x.acceptance_criteria: No Phase 2 file upload begins without the required current acceptance and rights acknowledgement, while microphone and legacy paths follow the frozen policy rather than an accidental blanket block. Windows, macOS and Telegram show equivalent RU and EN text and exact policy links. Version change, revoke or actor mismatch has a deterministic result, and records prove acceptance without claiming ownership or legal validity beyond the approved policy.

TASK-260712-2eympi.title: Publish a go or no-go codec and player ADR
TASK-260712-2eympi.acceptance_criteria: The ADR names one complete production combination with exact versions and obligations that passes every hard gate, or explicitly blocks Phase 2 with no winner. It cannot average away a failed format, platform, license or Store constraint. Downstream tasks can implement without changing codec, container, integrity, seek, cache, timing or package assumptions.

TASK-260712-2g3fkt.title: Independent Phase 2 codec, license and supply-chain review
TASK-260712-2g3fkt.acceptance_criteria: An independent source-linked report either accepts one exact Windows plus macOS combination or blocks Phase 2. Critical and high findings are fixed and re-reviewed; legal unknowns remain explicit. No unsigned, downloaded, untracked or license-ambiguous decoder enters root review.

TASK-260712-2h6snp.title: Orchestrate uploaded tracks as a general main-program source
TASK-260712-2h6snp.acceptance_criteria: Uploaded tracks queue or replace without corrupting Spotify or clip state; ready supported targets meet timing while unsupported targets are explicit. Pause, seek and resume are generation-safe, living-Air join catches up the main track but never old overlay, leave stops only leavers, coordinator restart preserves one current source and queue, and ended or progress reflects audible output rather than downloaded or decoded-ahead bytes.

TASK-260712-2i3u7v.title: Implement macOS saved and active Air management UI
TASK-260712-2i3u7v.acceptance_criteria: macOS can manage multiple saved Airs and one active Air with keyboard and VoiceOver access. Role, stale invite, capacity, concurrent change and offline errors are honest. Disruptive actions cannot occur accidentally, secrets are redacted, two-party aliases remain understandable and all commands use the common Air API.

TASK-260712-2j5fkr.title: Expose actor-scoped inbox, history, receipts and replay APIs
TASK-260712-2j5fkr.acceptance_criteria: Authorized actors see only their permitted items and receipts with stable pagination and accurate partial or unsupported state. Non-target, revoked and newly joined actors cannot infer an item by ID or cursor. Replay is always explicit, creates one new delivery or local playback, and fails honestly after expiry, delete or disable. Repeated or racing commands are idempotent and no inbox read changes playback.

TASK-260712-2nto40.title: Implement macOS Phase 2 targets and inbox UI
TASK-260712-2nto40.acceptance_criteria: macOS completes B5-B7 parity without displaying or constructing foreign targets. Consent, queue or replace, replay and moderation actions produce canonical outcomes; pagination and reconnect do not duplicate commands; every inbox playback requires an explicit current action; RU and EN keyboard and VoiceOver checks pass.

TASK-260712-2ogntd.title: Implement track storage, processing and egress accounting
TASK-260712-2ogntd.acceptance_criteria: Metrics reconcile to stored and served bytes across ingest, retry, range, cache refill, delete and retention. Quotas stop new work or follow the explicit active-playback policy with stable user errors, never leak another tenant or leave counters permanently charged after cleanup. Operator dashboards and tests prove section 20.5 storage and egress gates are actually functional.

TASK-260712-2psvhu.title: Implement macOS long-track upload and playback UI
TASK-260712-2psvhu.acceptance_criteria: macOS completes a one-hour B1 parity flow without external credentials or full-file memory, renders exact validation and progress, and controls queue, replace, pause, seek and resume accessibly. Reconnect and repeated commands do not duplicate, draft and consent rules hold, and clip or Spotify UI remains usable.

TASK-260712-2rlkp7.title: Freeze Phase 2 target, inbox and transport-parity contracts
TASK-260712-2rlkp7.acceptance_criteria: One reviewed contract gives API, storage, Windows, macOS and Telegram identical fields, enums, authorization, targeted-track, cursor, TTL, consent, mixed-version, replay and report or quarantine semantics. New members never discover old media, former targets follow only frozen retention, non-targets see nonexistence, a report cannot silently grant global censorship, and no task invents a second ACL, moderation or history model.

TASK-260712-2sicfs.title: Independent Phase 2 Air migration and concurrency review
TASK-260712-2sicfs.acceptance_criteria: An independent report proves transactional lifecycle and exactly one runtime owner with production-shaped upgrade or rollback evidence. Critical and high findings are fixed and re-reviewed; no duplicate, transitive or stale-link path remains.

TASK-260712-2ubzyf.title: Document streamed-track rollout, limits and handoff
TASK-260712-2ubzyf.acceptance_criteria: Engineers can enable streamed_tracks on an internal orbit with clear migration order, rollback expectations and operational metrics. Cross-story handoff to Air, explicit targets and acceptance evidence is explicit, and no document contradicts the codec decision or rights and deletion behavior.

TASK-260712-2vhf80.title: Implement authenticated Air lifecycle and activation APIs
TASK-260712-2vhf80.acceptance_criteria: Authorized actors complete lifecycle operations with stable errors; self or duplicate join, wrong confirmer, expired or replayed invite, concurrent consume, active-Air conflict, over-capacity and unauthorized policy or dissolve all fail deterministically without secret or room enumeration. Saved membership and active pointer remain consistent across restart and every accepted operation is audited.

TASK-260712-2vipy3.title: Build the shared Phase 2 target and inbox presentation model
TASK-260712-2vipy3.acceptance_criteria: Windows and macOS can render the complete Phase 2 flow from the same view model and command interfaces. Labels and allowed actions match Telegram semantics, capability and expiry changes update deterministically, and a UI cannot construct a target or action not returned by the server. Before implementation continues, the task branch must fetch origin and be rebased onto the latest origin/main; conflicts must be resolved without dropping unrelated board changes, and git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD must succeed before review handoff.

TASK-260712-2zdetx.title: Add secure Telegram Air lifecycle parity
TASK-260712-2zdetx.acceptance_criteria: Telegram and Pulsar perform identical authorized Air transitions, policy changes and errors. A group member cannot confirm or switch another Barycenter without role, forged, stale or repeated callbacks cannot act, invites remain single-use and redacted, and legacy approach or apart wording continues through the same service with no duplicate runtime.

TASK-260712-2zoy4u.title: Extend canonical rights and moderation enforcement to tracks and inbox
TASK-260712-2zoy4u.acceptance_criteria: B7 passes through the same app and Telegram workflow: missing consent blocks applicable upload, every accessible foreign item is reportable, the reporter is protected immediately, and an authorized delete or disable decision prevents direct URL, range, cache-refill, queue and inbox access. A malicious report cannot globally censor content by itself. Existing blocks, reports and audits remain the source of truth and no transport special case bypasses enforcement.

TASK-260712-31rkpe.title: Freeze and implement the streamed-track protocol contract
TASK-260712-31rkpe.acceptance_criteria: All three codecs round-trip identical generation-safe payloads and old messages. A stale ready, seek, progress or ended event cannot affect a newer generation; nodes never start before the buffer barrier; unsupported Phase 1 nodes are visibly handled by the sender-selected policy without blocking supported targets or silent autoplay; protocol and mixed-version goldens pass.

TASK-260712-31zja2.title: Implement Windows saved and active Air management UI
TASK-260712-31zja2.acceptance_criteria: Windows can manage multiple saved Airs and one active Air with keyboard, screen-reader and high-DPI access. Role, stale invite, capacity, concurrent change and offline errors are honest. Disruptive actions cannot occur accidentally, secrets are redacted, two-party aliases remain understandable and all commands use the common Air API.

TASK-260712-350u8d.title: Probe native macOS AVFoundation or AudioToolbox streaming
TASK-260712-350u8d.acceptance_criteria: A reproducible native macOS prototype passes the same hard gates as every other candidate or produces exact rejection evidence. It can be paired explicitly with a Windows candidate in the ADR, does not hide full-file buffering or render I/O, and names every unsupported format or OS version rather than assuming parity.

TASK-260712-3aj8w2.title: Implement the macOS bounded streaming provider
TASK-260712-3aj8w2.acceptance_criteria: macOS starts before full download with p95 at most 5 s, seeks to audio p95 at most 3 s, stays at or below 200 MiB RSS for B1 and remains duration-bounded at two hours. It rejects stale generations, survives network resets and eviction, purges revoked cache, reports ended after ring drain and passes realtime, clip, Spotify and output regressions.

TASK-260712-3lf8r0.title: Serve private authenticated stream variants by range
TASK-260712-3lf8r0.acceptance_criteria: Nodes resume and seek without full redownload and receive stable bytes for one variant version. Non-targets cannot infer media or variant IDs, intermediaries cannot leak authenticated content and range abuse is bounded. Conditional requests detect replacement, delete or disable blocks future range immediately, plain report follows the reviewed anti-abuse policy, and 200, 206, HEAD, If-Range, 416, quota and revocation tests pass.

TASK-260712-3lximx.title: Implement Windows long-track upload and playback UI
TASK-260712-3lximx.acceptance_criteria: Windows completes a one-hour B1 user flow without external credentials or full-file memory, renders exact server validation and progress, and controls queue, replace, pause, seek and resume accessibly. Reconnect and repeated commands do not duplicate, draft and consent rules hold, and clip or Spotify UI remains usable.

TASK-260712-3n36ny.title: Add Air persistence and transactional link-to-Air migration
TASK-260712-3n36ny.acceptance_criteria: Fresh and upgraded databases restore saved, parked and active state with a transactional one-active invariant. Every link maps to one two-member Air without duplicate membership or delivery. Partial migration rolls back atomically, restart does not repeat backfill, and the previous coordinator can provide documented legacy service without deleting Phase 2 data or resurrecting a parallel link runtime.

TASK-260712-3nq0tq.title: Prove Air lifecycle, migration, isolation and capacity
TASK-260712-3nq0tq.acceptance_criteria: Automated evidence proves Air state and one-active invariants, exact B2-B4 lifecycle behavior available within this story, no duplicate or transitive runtime, no invite or role bypass, lazy park and clean leave, additive migration and non-dual rollback. The initial 8 or 20 load either passes named limits or records a concrete blocker; streamed-track catch-up and target-security dependencies are explicit rather than falsely marked passed.

TASK-260712-3vkcki.title: Probe exact pure-Go streaming candidates on both platforms
TASK-260712-3vkcki.acceptance_criteria: A pure-Go combination passes the identical Windows and macOS hard gates with pinned versions and artifacts, or every failure is concrete rejected-option evidence. No C wrapper is mislabeled pure Go, no full-file allocation or crash on hostile input is tolerated, and the adapter seam remains usable by the streamed-track story.

TASK-260712-cuplon.title: Implement Windows Phase 2 targets and inbox UI
TASK-260712-cuplon.acceptance_criteria: Windows completes B5-B7 UI paths without displaying or constructing foreign targets. Consent, queue or replace, replay and moderation actions produce the canonical outcomes; pagination and reconnect do not duplicate commands; every inbox playback requires an explicit current action; RU and EN accessibility and DPI checks pass.

TASK-260712-dqdoqj.title: Prototype canonical variants, authenticated ranges and bounded cache
TASK-260712-dqdoqj.acceptance_criteria: One reviewed contract supports prepare and arbitrary seek by ranges for every candidate, with stable RFC-compatible headers, no bearer in URLs, target ACL on every fetch and no cross-tenant cache oracle. Integrity detects corrupt or mixed versions before decode, VBR seeking is deterministic, cache disk and memory are hard-bounded, and revoke or delete prevents refill and removes or invalidates cached access according to policy.

TASK-260712-ibuaxj.title: Run the complete comparative codec and player matrix
TASK-260712-ibuaxj.acceptance_criteria: The evidence pack maps every proof and threshold to raw comparable artifacts, includes all three platform pairings and cannot hide a failed format behind a combined score. Rejected candidates have reproducible failure evidence. At least one complete Windows plus macOS production combination passes every hard gate before selection can proceed.

TASK-260712-kr64r2.title: Make stable Air ID the sole shared-runtime owner
TASK-260712-kr64r2.acceptance_criteria: A+B+C own exactly one runtime and each target receives one command. Offline members do not block. Joining nodes catch up only the current main track by explicit living-Air rules and never hear stale overlay. A leaver stops locally without disturbing remaining nodes, saved or parked rooms consume no live session resources, and no stale link, other saved Air or restart can steal ownership or create a transitive chain.

TASK-260712-n11rg6.title: Independent Phase 2 target, range and rights security review
TASK-260712-n11rg6.acceptance_criteria: The independent report finds no target enumeration, range or cache leak, stale replay, cursor oracle, consent bypass, global-report abuse or transport disparity. All critical and high findings are fixed and re-reviewed before root acceptance.

TASK-260712-qi81vf.title: Integrate privacy-safe Phase 2 operational evidence views
TASK-260712-qi81vf.acceptance_criteria: B1-B7 and beta evidence can be queried from canonical counters that reconcile to implementation metrics and quota state. Readiness detects broken enabled processing, storage or Air runtime before rollout. Flags off preserve Phase 1 health, label cardinality and retention are bounded, and exported metrics reveal no content or tenant identifiers.

TASK-260712-wt2n7m.title: Add Telegram Air, N-target and track parity
TASK-260712-wt2n7m.acceptance_criteria: Telegram audio or document and app actions create identical media, queue or replace, target snapshot, consent, receipt, inbox and moderation semantics. Forged or stale callbacks cannot select foreign targets or replay hidden media. No personal-delivery broadcast fallback, raw ID, silent mixed-version behavior or transport-owned queue logic remains.
